title: Transfer and Norm for Finite Group Schemes
summary: We develop the theory of transfer and norm maps for finite group schemes, extending classical results from finite group theory to a context where induction and restriction are not necessarily bi-adjoint. In the additive setting, we construct a transfer map for both modules and $\rm Ext $ groups and prove that its surjectivity characterizes relative projectivity, establishing a generalization of Higman's criterion.
